title: API proposal: transformProvidedProps as a way to modify widgets providedProps.

comments.body:
This is good we can move on implementing,
also add a guide like "Sorting and filtering items" something like that?

> After some second thoughts, why not restrict the scope of this function to only the items provided prop as it will be for now only used when filtering or sorting items.

I think I like this way more. The intention is clearer. Proposal for an other name: `transformProvidedProps`.
Argh my bad, I meant `transformProvidedItems` but I also like `transformItems` :)
